criteria.title: Factual correctness
criteria.description: Does the answer correctly reflect the key concepts/facts in the selected textbook section?

levels.description: Many key facts are missing or incorrect.
Some key facts are correct, but several omissions or minor errors.
All major key facts are correct (only minor errors if any).

criteria.title: Coverage of section scope
criteria.description: Did the answer cover the relevant parts of the ToC section (and any included subsections)?

levels.description: Very limited scope; major areas of the section aren’t addressed.
Partial coverage; some important parts of the section are missing.
Comprehensive coverage of the section’s required scope.

criteria.title: Use of section-specific terminology/structure
criteria.description: Does the answer incorporate relevant terms, definitions or structure from the textbook section?

levels.description: Minimal or no use of relevant terminology or structure from the section.
Some correct use of terminology/structure, but inconsistent or incomplete.
Clear and consistent use of correct terms and structure from the section.

criteria.title: Explanation and logical coherence
criteria.description: Is the answer logically organized, flows well, and explains rather than just listing facts?

levels.description: Explanation is unclear or disorganized; mostly lists facts without structure.
Some organization and explanation, but could be deeper or more coherent.
Clear, well-organized explanation; facts embedded within coherent structure.

criteria.title: Depth of understanding and application
criteria.description: Does the answer go beyond surface-level recall — explaining why/how things work, connecting ideas, or applying the concept to an example?

levels.description: Only restates definitions or facts verbatim; no explanation of mechanisms or connections between ideas.
Shows some understanding beyond recall; partial explanation of why/how, or limited connection between concepts.
Demonstrates clear understanding: explains mechanisms, draws meaningful connections, or applies concepts beyond surface recall.

interpretation.9-10: Mastery: Answer is accurate, full, well-explained, and clearly grounded in the section.
interpretation.6-8: Proficient: Good work with some minor gaps (coverage or explanation could improve).
interpretation.0-5: Needs Review: Significant omissions/errors, weak explanation, or lack of grounding in this section.
